vson_p:
# Ditransitive: "the merchant gives the apple to the child."
# Demonstrates: agent + theme + recipient (the AMR :ARG0/:ARG1/:ARG2 alignment).

(scene / Composition
   :framedBy (cam / CameraView :angle eye_level :focalLength 50mm :framing medium_shot)
   :viewedBy cam
   :depicts (merchant / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Generic :animacy Agentive :countability Count
               :class Human
               :hasQuality (qr / Quality :dimension Role :value merchant))
   :depicts (child / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Generic :animacy Agentive :countability Count
               :class Human
               :hasQuality (qa / Quality :dimension Age :value child))
   :depicts (apple / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Generic :animacy Inert :countability Count
               :class Apple
               :hasQuality (qc / Quality :dimension Color :value red))
   :occurs (give / Event
              :lemma give
              :agent merchant
              :theme apple
              :recipient child))
